description: Read: the flash items your wallet holds and has not used yet, live from the chain, on BOTH the live Games Master v2 contracts and the retired legacy ones (each item says which contractSet): sealed or openable Black Market crates (state sealed, posting or ready), unused Portal disks (expiry) and mercenaries (type, expiry, whether already on a crew). The contracts have no owner index, so the lists come from reading the newest 400 ids per kind per set and stop once your balance is accounted for (each list says whether it is complete); at most 50 ids per kind. Then use prepare_open_crate, prepare_use_portal, prepare_hire_merc. Read only.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: my_shop_items
